items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: So he went back to Japan and told Koyama that I was interested.

ctx.x: So he came and asked me, (he said, in Japan?) He wanted me to go over there and do some concerts, and make a couple of albums. So I said fine. He was a very nice man. He'd been a jazz fan for years. He was all enthused with American jazz.

So he went back to Japan and told Koyama that I was interested. And finally he came over with his own photographer and the whole thing. Sometime when you come I'll show you the pictures they took. Really the pictures they took (in this magazine... ?). So that way we made (a connection?) and we went to Japan.
